lines: The world itself: those are his powers —
l4.sanskrit_cite: kiṃ bahunā yat viśvaṃ tā asya śaktayaḥ tāḥ katham upadeṣṭuṃ śakyāḥ iti

reads_against.argmap: Can the powers be taught? → Rhetorical: world = powers = unteachable-as-list — sets up the counted schemes as approximation.
c1_essence: Why teach them? World = his powers.
